publication.title: Lorundrostat in Participants With Uncontrolled Hypertension and Treatment-Resistant Hypertension: The Launch-HTN Randomized Clinical Trial
publication.studyDesignAsReported: Phase 3 randomized double-blind placebo-controlled clinical trial
publication.publisherReportedPrimaryOutcome: Change in automated office systolic blood pressure at week 6, 50 mg lorundrostat vs placebo
publication.publisherReportedSafetyCaveat: Hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, and reduction in kidney function were more frequent with lorundrostat than placebo.
